content.text: 00022570: mov.l 0x00022688,r4 ; 2026-09-12 AVLS follow-up: this primary fuel lookup passes saved B438 load in FR4 and B544 RPM in FR5 to descriptor 5FA9C, then 5FAB8 at 2257C. A/B are not directly indexed by CD86 here. Current-v2 numerical comparison is in V2_AVLS_NEUTRAL_20260912.md; the 13:37 log omits B438, CL/OL state and composed fuel factor, so illustrative raw-SD-load table results are NOT a measured target AFR.

0002084e: cmp/eq #0x1,r0 ; 2026-09-12 AVLS/fueling check: stack byte is committed CD86, captured at 207C6/207CA. Mode 1 is required for the auxiliary lookup to B908. However stock AND current v2 have 75E62=75E64=0: preceding unsigned-counter gates require B68A > lower AND B68A < upper, an empty interval. This routine therefore writes zero at 20862..20866 under those calibrations; it cannot explain this capture's high-lift rich step. No native code/calibration change applied.

limits: Ghidra program contains the stock ROM; current calibration comparisons used the SHA-pinned local v2 image.
Primary table illustrations use raw modeled load at fixed IAT fixtures, not measured conditioned load or a reconstructed live target.
